hangar.billing.v1alpha1.PriceEntry.description: PriceEntry is a set of prices and when it takes effect.

effectiveTime.description: When the prices take effect, on a whole minute.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.PriceListSpec.description: PriceListSpec is the currency and the prices over time.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code every price is in, such as "TWD".

entries.description: The prices, each from its effective_time on, until the next entry's, in order of effective_time. An entry whose time has come is never changed or removed: an apply may only add entries, at the end, that take effect now or later. A minute before the first entry is free.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.PriceListStatus.description: PriceListStatus is the observed state of a price list.

hangar.billing.v1alpha1.Prices.description: Prices are what holding one unit of each thing for an hour costs, as a decimal in the currency's units with at most six digits after the point, such as "0.6". A minute costs a sixtieth of the hour. A price left empty is free, but for a burstable machine's vCPUs. cpu and memory count only while a machine runs; everything else counts while it exists, as the quota counts it (Limits).

cpuBurstable20.description: Per vCPU of a running burstable machine whose resources.cpu_baseline is 20, in place of cpu. Empty is cpu's price times 0.2, never free.

cpuBurstable40.description: Per vCPU of a running burstable machine whose resources.cpu_baseline is 40, in place of cpu. Empty is cpu's price times 0.4, never free.

hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: PriceList is what Hangar charges for each thing a tenant holds, by the hour, each price from the time it takes effect. A pay-as-you-go BillingAccount is rated by one, minute by minute, at the prices in effect in that minute, so a new price never changes what was already used. Platform administrators keep price lists; everyone allowed to use Hangar reads them. See docs/decisions/billing.md.
title: PriceList
